info.name: Realhive Group of Supermarkets POS API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the POS, through the API gateway. Generated from the services' OpenAPI specs by `make postman`.

1. Import this collection and an environment (postman/pos-api.postman_environment.json, or postman/local.postman_environment.json after `make demo-seed`, which holds real ids).
2. Run *Start here > Sign in*: the token is stored and used by every other request.
3. Ids in paths are variables ({{productId}}, {{saleId}}, ...): set them in the environment, or from a previous response.
